transaction_id.description: Unique payment identifier within this batch. Leading zeros are significant.

user_id.description: Sender account identifier, in the same namespace as recipient_id.

recipient_id.description: Recipient account identifier. It need not appear as a sender in this batch.

amount_tnd.description: Positive payment amount in Tunisian dinars, to three decimal places.

timestamp.description: Payment event time normalized to UTC, for example 2026-10-29T09:00:00.000Z.

governorate.description: Canonical Tunisian governorate name. Raw imports accept case-insensitive names.

device_id.description: Optional device identifier. An empty string means no device was supplied.

reported_scam.description: Explicit customer report supplied with the data. Never inferred by the scorer.

expected_fraud.description: Optional supplied evaluation outcome. Null means unlabeled, not legitimate.

description: CSV input is normalized before crossing this boundary. All ten fields are materialized. Optional device identifiers default to an empty string, reported_scam defaults to false and missing evaluation labels remain null. Timestamps are UTC with millisecond precision. No arrival-order or freshness guarantee applies to user-supplied historical batches.
